_doc: Per-character settings for generate.py; see docs/generative-portraits.md. Variant ids are files of the `dune-hd heads` dump: fNN = a frame the game lists, vNN = part group NN drawn over frame 0. method: rerender (default; shapes) or recolour (colours; 'over' = the frame it is drawn over, default the base). kind is a label for people (and for a future openness heuristic). mouths: settings for every mouth group without its own entry (var_prompt, negative, settings).

HAWA._doc: His f00's look is the batch's ('the subject as drawn' with the game's style layers). Note from the user on f00 (2026-10-16), on the tuft above his far brow that the batch drew as an antenna: 'this is bushy eyebrows, make them on both sides'. It applies to every frame and talking group. The prompt alone does not change the eyebrows (the pixel art steers them), so each is repainted in a close-up after generation ("touch": the far one, the raised tuft sticking out past his brow, seen against the background; the near one, over the eye). 'a man': without it he reads as a woman; 'elderly' brings a white moustache. v04, v06, v20 and v40 (around the mouth) grew a pale moustache: told clean-shaven. v28 (a frown) has its own near-eyebrow touch: the frown's folds were painted as lips.
